newsitem.title: GERMANY: German telecoms, computer firms creating jobs - Ifo.
newsitem.headline: German telecoms, computer firms creating jobs - Ifo.

text.p: Germany's telecommunications and data processing sectors will be the only industries to create a significant number of jobs in 1997, the Ifo economic research institute said.

Business sentiment in the sectors during the second quarter of 1997 was better than at any time in more than two years, with sales this year expected to grow by eight percent, Ifo said in a study to be published on Monday.
Two out of three firms planned to hire staff by the end of the year, mainly on a full-time basis.

Companies in the sector, which expect to generate combined sales of just under 184 billion marks in 1997, saw an improvement in business during the first quarter and are confident of maintaining a strong growth in the coming months, Ifo said.
Nine out of 10 firms plan to expand their business in the coming three to five years, with medium and large firms in western Germany particularly upbeat, Ifo said.
Within the sectors, software and services providers are expected to generate sales growth of seven percent in 1997 after six percent in 1996.
Consultancy and project services are also growing strongly while networks and systems providers are experiencing weak growth, Ifo said.
